name: ops-desk-16
description: 16 synthetic back-office tasks: 8 field extractions graded field by field, 8 spreadsheet formulas graded by running them. Written for this example; MIT like the rest of the repository.
conventions: Money amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit (ISO 4217): 1234.50 EUR is 123450, 480000 JPY is 480000.
Currencies are ISO 4217 codes; countries are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes.
Phone numbers are E.164: + and country code, digits only.
Rates and shares are decimal fractions: 19% is 0.19.
Card digits and other identifiers are strings; counts are numbers.
A field the document does not give is null.
Formulas must run in Excel 2016: no XLOOKUP, FILTER, UNIQUE, MAXIFS, MINIFS, IFS, SWITCH, TEXTJOIN, CONCAT or LET.
